1

2 Application seek quashing of FIR No.681/2019 as well as the proceedings in Special Case No.31/2020 invoking sections 366(A), 376 of the IPC read with Sections 4, 5(j)
(l) and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3 Though none represent the applicant today, we have perused the orders passed by this Court on previous occasion where the Court has noted that the trial court has already framed charge against the applicant and the matter was posted for recording of evidence of the prosecutrix and this was so recorded Tilak 2/2 26 APL 129-23.doc in the order dated 2/3/2023.
4.
Definitely, the trial must have moved ahead as we are in November, 2025.

In the wake of the aforesaid, since even the applicant do not appear to be interested in prosecuting the present application seeking quashing of the criminal proceedings pending against the him, we dismiss the Criminal Application.
